```python
import hashlib, json
from Crypto.Cipher import ChaCha20

# SHA-256 K constants
K = [...64 constants...]

def compress(state, block):
    # state: list of 8 ints; block: 64 bytes
    w = list(struct.unpack(">16I", block))
    for i in range(16, 64):
        s0 = rotr(w[i-15],7) ^ rotr(w[i-15],18) ^ (w[i-15]>>3)
        s1 = rotr(w[i-2],17) ^ rotr(w[i-2],19) ^ (w[i-2]>>10)
        w.append((w[i-16]+s0+w[i-7]+s1) & 0xffffffff)
    a,b,c,d,e,f,g,h = state
    for i in range(64):
        S1 = rotr(e,6)^rotr(e,11)^rotr(e,25)
        ch = (e&f)^(~e&g)
        t1 = (h+S1+ch+K[i]+w[i]) & 0xffffffff
        S0 = rotr(a,2)^rotr(a,13)^rotr(a,22)
        maj = (a&b)^(a&c)^(b&c)
        t2 = (S0+maj)&0xffffffff
        h=g; g=f; f=e; e=(d+t1)&0xffffffff; d=c; c=b; b=a; a=(t1+t2)&0xffffffff
    return [(x+y)&0xffffffff for x,y in zip(state,[a,b,c,d,e,f,g,h])]
```

def rotr(x, n): return ((x >> n) | (x << (32 - n))) & 0xffffffff

def compress(state, block):
    w = list(struct.unpack(">16I", block))
    for i in range(16, 64):
        s0 = rotr(w[i-15],7) ^ rotr(w[i-15],18) ^ (w[i-15] >> 3)
        s1 = rotr(w[i-2],17) ^ rotr(w[i-2],19) ^ (w[i-2] >> 10)
        w.append((w[i-16] + s0 + w[i-7] + s1) & 0xffffffff)
    a,b,c,d,e,f,g,h = state
    for i in range(64):

        ch = (e & f) ^ (~e & g & 0xffffffff)
        t1 = (h + S1 + ch + K[i] + w[i]) & 0xffffffff
        S0 = rotr(a,2) ^ rotr(a,13) ^ rotr(a,22)

def finish_state(state, data):
    p = data + b"\x80"

    st = list(state)

    return b"".join(struct.pack(">I", w) for w in st)

    return hmac_std(prk, info + b"\x01")

def section_aad(aad, ctx): return aad + b"\x00" + ctx.encode()

def main(path):

    def opensec(sec, ctx):

    man = env["i"]
    cfg = json.loads(opensec(man, man["a"]))
    print("\n===== CONFIG (manifest) =====")
    print(json.dumps(cfg, indent=1, ensure_ascii=False)[:3000])
    out = {"config": cfg, "profiles": {}}

        if pt.startswith(b"HPR1"):
            rt = pt[4:]
            packed = xopen(key, rt[:24], rt[24:], section_aad(aad, f"{sid}:r"))
            out["profiles"][sid] = packed.decode("utf-8", "replace")
        else:
            out["profiles"][sid] = pt.decode("utf-8", "replace")
        if sec.get("d"):
            dd = sec["d"]

            out.setdefault("payloads", {})[sid] = x.decode("utf-8", "replace")
    print("\n===== PROFILES =====")
    print(json.dumps(out["profiles"], indent=1, ensure_ascii=False)[:3000])

    print("\n[+] disimpan ke hc_isi.json")
